title: No Gifts Returned: Surprise Bonuses Reduce Productivity in a Natural Field Experiment
authors: Francesco Bogliacino; Gianluca F. Grimalda; David Pipke
eligible_reason: Randomized natural field experiment with one common treatment time. analysis_script.do line 47: d_afternoon = (hour >= 3), i.e. bonuses are announced after the two morning hours for every treated worker; the panel is worker x hour of the work day (xtset iid_person hour). Panel DiDs regress hourly characters typed on bono (or treatment-arm dummies x recipient status) x d_afternoon with worker FE (xtreg, fe) and hour dummies. Single adoption time and multi-arm treatment interactions; not staggered.
design_notes: Stata reg/xtreg. Main data: 237 workers (pairs) with 5 hourly productivity measures; follow-up experiment in additional_experiment.dta. Cross-sectional ANCOVA regressions of afternoon effort on treatment dummies controlling for morning output; within-worker DiDs (1.t_double 1.t_arbitrary 1.t_productivity 1.t_estrato)#1.d_afternoon#ib2.bonusrecipient i.hour.
data_files_note: Author-collected experimental data, fully shipped (README: all data necessary are included).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Field experiment with treatment at the same hour for all treated workers; not staggered.
